prompts.title: 3D Avatar Journey — Builders Journey Portfolio World
prompts.prompt:
Generate a 3D animated avatar of me using my image from [Image 1] folder (image: '20260603_214824-IMG_STYLE.jpg'). The avatar is fully interactable and controlled by pointer scrolling, creating a single continuous visual narrative across the entire website.

Core Concept: 'The Builder's Journey' — a cinematic 3D world where my character starts as a curious developer and walks through a connected landscape, with each section being a scene that reveals something about my career.

Technical Stack: Next.js, React Three Fiber, Three.js, Drei, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion. Avatar model created via Blender/Spline, animated via Mixamo. Camera moves on a spline path; character follows another spline path — no hard section jumps, everything is one continuous world.

Scene-by-Scene Breakdown:

1. HERO (Arrival): Camera is very close — only face visible. Idle animations: blinking, breathing, subtle head movement, eye tracking cursor. Background: floating particles, stars, subtle fog. Text: 'Hi, I'm Nitin. I build products that people remember.' On scroll, camera zooms out revealing shoulders then torso.

2. ABOUT (Walking Begins): Full upper body visible. Character walks. Ground emerges beneath. Floating cards appear — character taps them, cards unfold with GSAP morph animation showing About Me, Location, Experience, Interests.

3. SKILLS (Magic Forest): A magical forest where each tree represents a skill (React Tree, Next.js Tree, TypeScript Tree, Three.js Tree, Node.js Tree). As character walks, trees grow from ground. Character touches them, leaves burst, skill percentage appears.

4. PROJECTS (Cityscape): Projects become buildings (SaaS Project Tower, AI Platform Building, E-commerce Mall, Dashboard Headquarters). Character walks through city. On click, building expands, camera zooms inside, project details appear, character points toward it.

5. EXPERIENCE (Code Factory): Character enters futuristic factory. Machines represent APIs, Databases, Backend Systems, Automation. Conveyor belts, moving gears, floating code particles. Character presses buttons, machines activate.

6. TIMELINE (Bridge): Giant bridge where each milestone is a checkpoint (2022→Learning, 2023→First Client, 2024→First SaaS, 2025→AI Projects, 2026→Current). Character walks across, objects rise from below at each milestone.

7. ACHIEVEMENTS (Mountain): Character climbs a mountain. Achievements are floating crystals (Certifications, Hackathons, Awards, Open Source). Character grabs crystal, crystal emits particles, achievement card appears.

8. PLAYGROUND: Interactive section — user clicks buttons to make character wave, dance, sit, jump.

9. CONTACT (Campsite): Character reaches campsite at sunset. Warm atmosphere, small campfire, character sits. Social links appear around fire. Fire particles, smoke, glowing lights. Character waves when user hovers over buttons.

FOOTER (Journey Completed): Grass field, campfire, fireflies, sunset, stars appearing. Character slowly sits down, looks at sky, laptop beside him. Text: 'Thanks for visiting. Let's build something amazing together.' Buttons: Hire Me, View Resume, LinkedIn, GitHub. Character waves on button hover.

Camera follows character through a spline path. Every section blends into the next — no hard section jumps. Think Pixar intro, Apple product storytelling, Awwwards-winning cinematic experience.

prompts.title: 3D Avatar Journey — The Cyber Explorer Portfolio World

Generate a 3D animated avatar of me using my image from [Image 1] folder (image: '20260603_214824-IMG_STYLE.jpg'). The avatar is fully interactable with all backgrounds and controlled by pointer scrolling, creating a single continuous visual narrative across the entire website.

Theme: 'The Cyber Explorer' — a mix of Automation + Cyber Security. Aesthetic is Modern Cyberpunk + Futuristic Engineer + Ethical Hacker + Builder. NOT anonymous-mask hacker or green Matrix rain. Think: futuristic, intelligent, sophisticated, cinematic, premium.

Technical Stack: Next.js, React Three Fiber, Three.js, Drei, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion. Avatar via Blender/Spline, animated via Mixamo. Master timeline using GSAP ScrollTrigger where scroll controls: character position, camera position, background evolution, environment assets, lighting changes. Camera moves on a spline path; character follows another spline path — no hard section jumps, one continuous evolving world.

Character Actions Per Section: Hero: Looking at user. About: Walking forward. Education: Studying holograms. Experience: Activating memory portals. Skills: Interacting with skill orbs. Projects: Building structures. GitHub: Manipulating code streams. Blog: Reading floating articles. Testimonials: Receiving recommendation signals. Contact: Sitting in grass field.

Background Evolution (one world that transforms): 1. HERO — Deep-space digital environment. Dark blue/black. Particles, floating geometry, neural-network connections. Face emerges from darkness. Typing effect. Social icons float nearby. 2. ABOUT — Darkness reveals terrain. Digital ground forms. World illuminates. Floating memories appear. Interests become holographic objects (laptop, drone, terminal, books, AI orb). Character interacts with them. 3. EDUCATION — Terrain transforms into futuristic archive. Floating holographic timeline. Certificates become glowing panels. Degrees become digital monuments. Character walks through timeline portals. Hover activates timeline events. 4. EXPERIENCE — Character enters Memory Corridor. Each company/job becomes a portal. Hovering opens achievements, technologies used, impact metrics. Environment becomes more advanced with futuristic architecture. 5. SKILLS — Cyber Laboratory. Skills become energy cores (Frontend Core, Backend Core, Cloud Core, Security Core, AI Core, DevOps Core). Character touches them, they light up. Circular progress animations. Character passes through a firewall that opens to reveal technologies behind it. 6. PROJECTS — Innovation District. Projects become buildings that rise from ground, glow when selected. BLOG — Calmer environment. Floating digital papers. Articles orbit character. Selected paper unfolds showing preview. Background shifts toward warmer colors. 9. TESTIMONIALS — Brighter environment. Character slowly sits down, looks at horizon, stars appear.

Security Enthusiast Theme (subtle): Gradually reveals packet streams, network nodes, security shields, threat visualizations, encrypted data cubes, scanning effects throughout the experience.

Additional Interactive Objects: Drone Companion (small AI drone follows character, helps reveal content, acts as cursor guide). Floating Terminal (appears near GitHub/Skills sections, displays commands, logs, security scans). Security Scanner (sweeps across environment on scroll, reveals hidden Easter eggs). Hidden Terminal Mode (Konami code unlocks Cyber Lab Mode showing certifications, security labs, bug bounty achievements, CTF wins, hacking projects).

The avatar must be interactive with ALL backgrounds — responding to environment changes, pointing at objects, touching/hovering interactive elements, sitting/standing based on section. Think Pixar intro, Apple product storytelling, Awwwards-winning cinematic single-shot experience.

prompts.title: UI/UX Design System — Cyber Automation Visual Identity
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a Senior UI/UX Design Systems Lead and Senior Product Designer. Create a complete design system for a premium cinematic 3D portfolio website themed around Automation Engineering + Cyber Security + AI Systems.

Design Philosophy

- Futuristic but professional
- Cinematic and immersive
- Minimal yet high-tech
- Accessible and responsive
- Consistent across all sections

Visual Identity

Theme: “The Cyber Automation Journey”

Aesthetic:
- Glassmorphism
- Crystal UI
- Aurora gradients
- Soft neon lighting
- Depth and layered surfaces
- Premium enterprise interface design

Color Palette

| Token          | Value                  |
| -------------- | ---------------------- |
| Primary        | #00E5FF                |
| Secondary      | #7B61FF                |
| Accent         | #00FF9D                |
| Background     | #050816                |
| Surface        | rgba(255,255,255,0.05) |
| Surface Strong | rgba(255,255,255,0.08) |
| Border         | rgba(255,255,255,0.12) |
| Text Primary   | #FFFFFF                |
| Text Secondary | #A1A1AA                |
| Success        | #00FF9D                |
| Warning        | #FFB800                |
| Error          | #FF4D6D                |

Typography

Primary Font: Inter or Geist
Display Font: Space Grotesk or Sora

Type Scale:
| Style      | Size | Weight |
| ---------- | ---- | ------ |
| Display XL | 72px | 700    |
| Display LG | 56px | 700    |
| H1         | 48px | 700    |
| H2         | 36px | 700    |
| H3         | 28px | 600    |
| H4         | 22px | 600    |
| Body LG    | 18px | 400    |
| Body       | 16px | 400    |
| Caption    | 14px | 400    |

Rules:
- Use high contrast ratios for accessibility.
- Display fonts only for headings and hero text.
- Body text must remain highly readable on dark backgrounds.

Spacing & Layout System

Base Grid: 8pt system

Spacing Tokens: xs 4px, sm 8px, md 16px, lg 24px, xl 32px, 2xl 48px, 3xl 64px, 4xl 96px.

Container Widths: Mobile 100%, Tablet 768px, Laptop 1200px, Desktop 1440px, Ultra-wide 1600px.

Component System

Buttons:
- Primary: neon gradient with glow
- Secondary: glass surface with subtle border
- Ghost: transparent with hover glow
- Magnetic hover interaction
- Minimum height: 44px

Cards:
- Glass background with blur
- Subtle border and inner highlight
- Soft shadow depth
- Hover: elevate + glow + slight tilt

Inputs:
- Rounded corners (16px)
- Glass background
- Strong focus ring using primary color
- Accessible labels and error states

Navigation:
- Transparent glass navbar
- Scroll-aware background opacity
- Animated active section indicator
- Mobile hamburger with smooth transition

Interaction Rules

- Hover transitions: 200–300ms ease-out
- Section reveal animations: 600–900ms
- Microinteractions should feel responsive but subtle
- Motion should reinforce hierarchy, not distract
- All interactive elements must have visible focus states

Responsive Behavior

- Hero text scales fluidly using clamp()
- Cards stack vertically on mobile
- Navigation collapses below 1024px
- 3D elements reduce complexity on low-end devices
- Touch targets minimum 44x44px

Accessibility Requirements

- WCAG AA contrast compliance
- Keyboard navigable components
- Reduced motion mode support
- Semantic HTML structure
- Screen reader friendly labels and landmarks

Deliverables

- Design token JSON structure
- Tailwind configuration guidance
- Component specifications
- Responsive layout rules
- Interaction and accessibility guidelines
- Example UI patterns for hero, cards, forms, and navigation

The final design system must ensure the entire portfolio feels visually unified, premium, futuristic, and production-ready.

prompts.title: Motion Design System — Cinematic Animation Choreography
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a Senior Motion Designer, GSAP Specialist, and Three.js Animation Director. Create a complete motion design system for a cinematic 3D portfolio website themed around Automation Engineering + Cyber Security + AI Systems.

The motion system must feel:
- Cinematic
- Premium
- Intentional
- Physics-aware
- Performance-friendly
- Consistent across all interactions

Motion Philosophy

- Motion should guide attention and reinforce storytelling.
- Animations must never feel random or decorative.
- Every transition should communicate state, hierarchy, or progression.
- The experience should resemble a polished interactive film rather than a flashy landing page.

Global Motion Tokens

Durations: instant 120ms, fast 200ms, normal 350ms, medium 600ms, slow 900ms, cinematic 1400ms.

Easing Curves: standard power2.out, emphasized power3.out, decelerate expo.out, overshoot back.out(1.7), gentle sine.inOut.

Motion Principles

- Use acceleration and deceleration naturally.
- Avoid linear motion except for background ambient effects.
- Stagger related elements by 40–80ms.
- Prefer transform and opacity animations for performance.
- Limit simultaneous complex animations.

Scroll Storytelling System

The website uses one master GSAP timeline controlled by scroll position.

Scroll Behavior:
1. Camera moves along a spline path through the 3D world.
2. Character movement is synchronized with camera progression.
3. Background environments blend gradually between sections.
4. Content reveals are tied to world progression, not isolated section triggers.
5. Transitions must feel seamless with no abrupt jumps.

Technical Guidance

- Use GSAP ScrollTrigger for timeline orchestration.
- Use Lenis for smooth scrolling.
- Use React Three Fiber animation mixer for character clips.
- Keep heavy animations inside requestAnimationFrame loops optimized for 60 FPS.

Section Motion Direction

Hero — Digital Awakening: Face emerges from darkness with soft light sweep. Particles drift slowly in depth. Typing effect appears sequentially. Character gives a subtle wave. CTA buttons float upward with magnetic hover.

About — Automation Ecosystem: Environment grows from abstract particles into structured workflow nodes. Stat counters animate upward on reveal. Interest cards orbit gently before settling. Character gestures toward active content.

Education — Knowledge Archive: Timeline lines draw themselves. Holographic cards unfold from the center. Certifications glow briefly on hover. Character pauses and examines floating holograms.

Experience — Operations Center: Memory portals activate with circular scan effects. Cards expand smoothly rather than popping open. Infrastructure lights pulse subtly in the background. Character sits briefly while reviewing systems.

Skills — Cyber Laboratory: Energy cores ignite one by one. Circular progress rings animate clockwise. Radar charts draw progressively. Character interacts with each core as it activates.

Projects — Innovation City: Buildings rise from the ground as the camera approaches. Hover causes slight camera focus and building expansion. Filtering reorganizes the city layout smoothly. Project details unfold from within structures.

GitHub Dashboard — Living Code Network: Contribution graph grows from terrain. Repository satellites orbit slowly. Data streams flow between nodes. Character manipulates holographic code panels.

Blog — Knowledge Nebula: Articles drift in parallax layers. Hover unfolds article cards like holographic pages. Background motion becomes calmer and more reflective.

Testimonials — Trust Network: Recommendation cards glide in a slow carousel. Soft pulse highlights the active testimonial. Avatars float with subtle depth movement. Character receives glowing recommendation signals.

Contact — Transition to Nature: Digital particles transform into fireflies. Network structures dissolve into organic shapes. Form fields rise gently into place. Paper airplane launches on successful submit.

Footer — Journey Completed: Character slowly sits on the grass. Sunset lighting warms over time. Stars fade in gradually. Ambient particles drift softly around the scene.

Microinteraction Rules

Buttons: Scale to 1.03 on hover. Glow intensifies slightly. Press state compresses to 0.98. Use spring-like easing for magnetic effect.

Cards: Translate upward 4–8px on hover. Rotate subtly toward cursor (max 4°). Shadow and border glow increase smoothly.

Inputs: Focus ring animates in 180ms. Label transitions upward smoothly. Error shake uses very small amplitude and short duration.

Ambient World Animation

Background elements should remain alive but unobtrusive. Examples: floating particles, moving data streams, rotating network nodes, breathing light gradients, slowly drifting holograms.

Rules:
- Motion speed should be slow and calming.
- Never distract from foreground content.
- Use additive blending and soft opacity.
- Reduce density on mobile devices.

Performance & Accessibility

- Target 60 FPS on modern devices.
- Prefer CSS transforms and opacity.
- Throttle mousemove interactions.
- Pause non-essential animations when tab is inactive.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion by simplifying or disabling cinematic effects.

Deliverables

- GSAP timeline structure
- Motion token definitions
- Section-by-section animation choreography
- Microinteraction specifications
- Performance guidelines
- Reduced-motion behavior plan

The final motion system should make the portfolio feel like a cohesive interactive film with elegant, purposeful movement throughout the entire journey.

prompts.title: SEO, GEO, Security & Performance — Full Production Strategy
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a combined team of: Senior SEO Strategist, Senior GEO (AI Search Optimization) Specialist, Senior Web Security Engineer, Senior Performance Engineer, Senior Accessibility Engineer, Senior Technical Content Strategist. Create a complete discoverability, security, and performance strategy for a premium 3D portfolio website for Nitin Kumar, a Python Developer, Automation Engineer, Cyber Security Enthusiast, and Data Science Learner.

The website uses: Next.js 15+, React 19+, Three.js / React Three Fiber, GSAP, Tailwind CSS.

Objectives

1. Rank well on Google and Bing
2. Be highly discoverable by AI search engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot)
3. Maintain enterprise-grade security
4. Achieve Lighthouse scores above 95
5. Support accessibility and fast loading globally

SEO Strategy

Primary Keywords: Nitin Kumar, Python Developer, Automation Engineer, Cyber Security Enthusiast, Data Science Learner, Web Developer, AI Automation Engineer, Cloud and Security Engineer.

Secondary Keywords: Python automation projects, Cyber security portfolio, Next.js developer portfolio, AI workflow automation, GitHub projects Python, Data science beginner portfolio.

Page Metadata: Generate optimized title tags (50–60 chars). Generate compelling meta descriptions (140–160 chars). Create Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata for every major section. Include canonical URLs and robots directives.

Structured Data: Person schema, Website schema, Breadcrumb schema, Article/BlogPosting schema for blog entries, FAQ schema for common questions, SameAs links for GitHub, LinkedIn, and social profiles.

Content Architecture: Use one clear H1 per page. Maintain semantic heading hierarchy (H1 → H2 → H3). Write concise, keyword-rich section introductions. Include descriptive alt text for all images. Generate internal links between projects, skills, blog posts, and contact sections.

GEO / AI Search Optimization

Entity Optimization: Clearly identify “Nitin Kumar” as a professional entity. Associate entities: Python, Automation Engineering, Cyber Security, Data Science, Web Development. Use consistent naming across metadata, schema, and visible content.

AI-Readable Content: Write concise summaries for each section. Use plain, factual language before decorative copy. Include Q&A style content for FAQ extraction. Add “What I do”, “Technologies I use”, and “Key achievements” summaries.

Knowledge Graph Signals: Link to authoritative profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn). Use structured data consistently. Include location, occupation, and skills in schema. Publish blog content regularly to strengthen topical authority.

AI Search Targets: Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude.

Security Strategy

HTTP Security Headers: Content-Security-Policy (CSP), Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.

Form & API Protection: CSRF protection, Rate limiting, Honeypot spam prevention, Server-side validation with Zod, reCAPTCHA or Cloudflare Turnstile integration, Sanitize all user input to prevent XSS.

Secrets & Environment Variables: Never expose API keys in the client bundle. Use .env.local and server-only environment variables. Rotate tokens periodically. Use least-privilege access for external APIs.

Infrastructure Security: Force HTTPS everywhere. Use secure cookies for authentication flows. Enable Vercel/Cloudflare DDoS protection. Log suspicious activity without storing sensitive data.

Performance Optimization

Target Metrics: Lighthouse Performance >95, Accessibility >95, Best Practices >95, SEO >95, CLS <0.1, LCP <2.5s, FID/INP <200ms.

Optimization Techniques: Use next/image with AVIF/WebP. Lazy load 3D scenes and heavy components. Code split non-critical routes and widgets. Compress GLTF models and textures. Use dynamic imports for Three.js sections. Reduce particle counts on mobile devices. Preload critical fonts and hero assets. Use server components where possible. Cache API responses and static assets aggressively.

3D Performance Rules: Target 60 FPS on desktop and 30+ FPS on mobile. Use LOD models for the avatar. Limit real-time shadows and expensive shaders. Pause offscreen animations. Use frustum culling and instancing where possible.

Accessibility Requirements: WCAG AA compliance. Keyboard navigation for all interactive elements. Visible focus states. Reduced motion mode for cinematic animations. ARIA labels for forms, buttons, and navigation. Proper semantic landmarks (header, main, footer). Descriptive alt text for all images and 3D fallbacks.

Analytics & Monitoring

Integrate: Vercel Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Plausible or PostHog (optional). Track: Section views, Scroll depth, CTA clicks, Resume downloads, Contact form submissions, Project interactions.

Deliverables

1. SEO metadata templates
2. JSON-LD schema snippets
3. robots.txt and sitemap configuration
4. Security header configuration for Next.js
5. Performance optimization checklist
6. Accessibility checklist
7. AI-search optimization recommendations
8. Monitoring and analytics setup instructions

prompts.title: World Environment Design — Background Evolution & Per-Section Landscapes
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a Senior 3D Environment Artist and World Builder. Design the complete background evolution system for a cinematic portfolio where a single 3D character walks through a continuously transforming world. The environment must evolve seamlessly from a digital cyber universe through technical/industrial landscapes and finally into a peaceful natural grassland.

Design Philosophy

- The background is ONE continuous world, not separate backgrounds per section
- Environments blend gradually with no hard cuts
- Each section's environment reflects its theme while transitioning naturally from the previous
- The world evolves from digital/abstract → structured/technical → organic/natural
- Lighting changes progressively throughout the journey
- All transitions must be driven by scroll position via GSAP ScrollTrigger master timeline

Background Evolution Per Section

HERO (Digital Awakening): Deep-space digital void. Dark blue/black color scheme. Floating particles with slow drift across multiple depth layers. Floating geometric shapes (icosahedrons, octahedrons, dodecahedrons). Neural-network-like connection lines between particles. Subtle volumetric fog for depth. Character face emerges from darkness center-frame.

ABOUT (Reality Forming): Darkness gradually reveals digital terrain grid. Grid-based ground plane materializes beneath character. World becomes more illuminated with soft ambient light. Floating memory orbs contain holographic previews. Interest icons float in orbit: laptop, drone, terminal, books, AI orb. Color shifts from deep black to dark blues and cyan-teal.

EDUCATION (Knowledge Archive): Terrain transforms into futuristic library/archive architecture. Floating holographic timeline panels with sequential milestones. Certificates as glowing translucent glass panels. Degrees as digital monument structures with particle emitters. Walkable timeline portals with glowing edges. Colors: deep blues with gold/amber accent highlights.

EXPERIENCE (Memory Corridor): Advanced futuristic architecture emerges with clean geometric forms. Each company/job = a distinct architectural portal with unique color identity. Portal edges glow with circular scan-line effects. Floating achievement metrics and KPI numbers orbit each portal. Background infrastructure lights pulse subtly (conveyor belts, server rack indicators). Colors: steel blues + electric cyan + warm amber.

SKILLS (Cyber Laboratory): Laboratory environment with floating energy core pedestals arranged in a circle. Each skill core has a distinct color (frontend=blue, backend=green, cloud=purple, security=red, AI=cyan, DevOps=orange). Firewall wall effect at entry with scan lines and hex grid overlay. Circular progress rings orbit each core. Floating code snippets in matrix-style columns behind cores. Colors: dark with vibrant energy core accent colors.

PROJECTS (Innovation District): Full cityscape with buildings of varying heights and architectural styles. Each building = a project with unique design (sleek glass tower, geometric tech block, crystalline data structure). Buildings rise from ground procedurally as camera approaches. Streets with glowing lane markers and data stream traffic. Hovering drone traffic between buildings. Colors: cyberpunk city neon blues, purples, warm lit windows.

GITHUB (Living Code Network): Terrain becomes a rolling data landscape. Contribution graph grid forms rolling hills topography. Repository satellites orbit in elliptical paths around character. Code streams flow like glowing rivers between data nodes. Language breakdown = differently colored energy streams emanating from character position. Floating commit particles rise from terrain like fire sparks. Colors: terminal-green, data-blue, commit-sparkle-amber.

BLOG (Knowledge Nebula): Calmer cosmic environment with warm ambient lighting. Floating digital paper sheets orbit in lazy elliptical arcs. Article previews as holographic scrolls with unfolding animation. Background color transitions from cool tech colors to warmer tones. Soft reading-light effect around character position. Colors: warm whites, soft ambers, transitioning to sunset hues.

TESTIMONIALS (Trust Network): Brighter, more open environment with soft golden light. Recommendation cards float in a circular carousel formation. Avatar thumbnails orbit with subtle floating animation. Connection lines with particle flow between recommender and character. Soft glowing particle trails. Colors: warm whites, gold accents, soft gradient backgrounds.

CONTACT → FOOTER (Nature Rising): Digital particles transform into organic fireflies. Grid terrain dissolves smoothly into natural grass with wind animation. Trees grow from geometric wireframes into full organic models. Network nodes become wildflowers and plants. Sunset lighting warms gradually with sun dipping below horizon. Campfire appears with particle ember system and smoke. Stars fade in as sky darkens to night. Laptop materializes on grass beside character. Colors: warm sunset magenta/orange/purple transitioning to night deep blue with white stars.

Environmental Effects Rules

- Particles: Max 2000 on desktop, 500 on mobile. Use instanced rendering
- Lights: Baked lighting where possible, limited to 2-3 real-time lights max
- Fog: Depth fog for atmosphere, color shifts per section
- Reflections: Screen-space reflections for cyber sections only
- Post-processing: Bloom (subtle 0.3 threshold), chromatic aberration (minimal 0.002), color grading lookup tables per section
- Performance: Frustum culling, LOD for all environment objects, instanced rendering for repeated elements (trees, buildings, particles)
- Transitions: Each environment blends over 15-20% scroll range, use crossfade between particle systems and geometry morphs

Deliverables

1. Per-section environment description with specific color palette, lighting setup, and key 3D assets
2. Transition method between each adjacent section pair
3. Environmental effects configuration (particles, fog, post-processing per section)
4. Mobile optimization rules (particle reduction, simplified geometry, disabled post-processing)
5. Lighting rig blueprint (ambient, directional, point lights per environment)
6. Texture and material atlas strategy for environment objects

prompts.title: Interactive Companion Objects — Drone, Terminal, Scanner & Hidden Mode
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a Senior Interactive Systems Designer and 3D Technical Artist. Design a set of companion interactive objects that follow the main character throughout the portfolio journey. These objects must enhance the storytelling, guide user attention, reveal content, and add depth to the cyber-automation theme without distracting from the main narrative.

Design Philosophy

- Objects must feel like natural extensions of the cyber-automation world
- Each object serves a functional purpose (guide, reveal, inform, reward)
- Interactions should feel delightful but not gimmicky
- Objects should respond to character proximity and scroll position
- Visual style must match the overall Cyber Explorer aesthetic (futuristic, premium, not cartoonish)

Object 1: Drone Companion

Purpose: AI-guided companion that follows character, reveals interactive elements, and directs user attention.

Design: Small quadcopter-style drone (size of a fist) with glowing cyan energy core. Minimalist industrial design with translucent protective panels. Light trail emitter traces its flight path. Soft glow illuminates nearby surfaces when hovering near interactive objects.

Behaviors:
- Follows character at shoulder height with 0.5s delayed offset (smooth follow with spring physics)
- When near an interactive element (card, button, core), drifts toward it and pulses its light 2x
- Acts as cursor guide: moves toward the closest interactable element as user scrolls
- Emits a thin beam of light pointing at clickable elements on first visit to each section
- Idle animation: gentle hover bobbing, occasional 360-degree slow rotation
- Reacts to character: if character touches an object, drone backs away slightly then returns
- Trail effect: emits subtle glowing particles along flight path that fade over 2 seconds

Technical Specs:
- Movement: Spring-based follow with damping. GSAP quickTo for position, or R3F useFrame with lerp
- Light: THREE.PointLight with dynamic intensity and color
- Trail: Particle system with 50-100 particles, size 0.02, color #00E5FF
- Collision: Simple radius-based avoidance with environment objects

Object 2: Floating Terminal

Purpose: Holographic command-line interface that appears near GitHub and Skills sections. Displays live commands, system logs, and security scan output.

Design: Translucent holographic panel (slight tilt, floats in air). CRT scan-line overlay effect. Green/cyan monochrome display. Text appears with typewriter effect. Panel has subtle glow border matching primary color.

Behaviors:
- Appears/disappears with holographic materialization effect (radial wipe + glow fade)
- Auto-types relevant commands based on current section:
  - Skills section: scanning skill cores, displaying proficiency percentages
  - GitHub section: git log --oneline, showing recent commits, repo stats
  - Experience section: displaying job history as system processes
  - Security sections: showing active firewall status, threat detection logs
- Hovering over terminal panel expands it to show full log history
- Scroll-linked content: as user scrolls through section, terminal output updates
- Error messages flash red briefly for attention-grabbing moments
- Occasional random keystroke sounds or visual feedback (subtle)

Technical Specs:
- Font: Monospace (JetBrains Mono or Fira Code) with glow effect
- Text reveal: GSAP TextPlugin or custom typewriter with 30-50ms per character
- Panel: PlaneGeometry with custom shader material for holographic effect
- Scan lines: Custom GLSL shader or sprite overlay with scrolling UV offset

Object 3: Security Scanner

Purpose: Environmental scanning effect that sweeps across the current scene, revealing hidden elements and Easter eggs.

Design: Not a physical object but a visual effect. A sweeping plane of light/scan lines passes through the environment. Creates hex-grid pattern overlay where it touches surfaces. Reveals hidden glowing elements in its wake.

Behaviors:
- Periodic sweep: auto-triggered every 10-15 seconds of scroll inactivity
- On user scroll: subtle continuous sweep tied to scroll velocity
- Where scanner passes over hidden elements, they briefly glow/activate:
  - Easter egg data cubes appear and rotate
  - Hidden skill percentages display momentarily
  - Security shield visualizations flicker into view
  - Encrypted data stream particles become visible
- Scanner effect: horizontal plane with hex pattern, travels from left to right across screen
- Duration: 1.5s per sweep with 0.5s fade in/out
- Color: cyan with 30% opacity, intensifies when hitting hidden elements

Technical Specs:
- Effect: Custom post-processing pass or overlay sprite with animated UV
- Trigger: setInterval for auto-sweep, scroll event listener for velocity-tied sweep
- Hidden elements: Pre-tagged objects with .easter-egg class or data attribute
- Reveal animation: GSAP stagger with opacity 0->1, scale 0.8->1

Object 4: Hidden Terminal (Cyber Lab Mode)

Purpose: Secret mode unlocked via Konami code or deliberate shortcut. Transforms the environment to reveal the security/cyber side of the portfolio in full.

The ultimate Easter egg for technical visitors and recruiters.

Activation: Konami code (up up down down left right left right b a) typed anywhere on page, or a deliberately hidden button (click logo 5 times rapidly, or type 'cyberlab' in the terminal).

Effects When Activated:
- Environment shifts: color grading changes to darker, more contrast-heavy palette
- Character puts on subtle holographic visor/glasses
- Terminal panel appears permanently in corner with real-time security scan data
- Hidden content is unlocked across all sections:
  - Certifications section: full list of security certifications with verification links
  - Security labs: CTF challenge completions, hackathon wins, bug bounty history

prompts.title: Scroll Storytelling System — Camera Spline, Master Timeline & Section Transitions
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a Senior Scroll Engineering Architect and Interactive Narrative Developer. Design the complete scroll-driven storytelling system that ties the entire portfolio together. The system must orchestrate camera movement, character animation, environment transitions, and content reveals along a single unified timeline controlled by scroll position.

Design Philosophy

- Scroll is not just a navigation mechanism — it is the primary storytelling control
- The experience must feel like controlling a camera through a cinematic world, not scrolling a webpage
- Every pixel of scroll distance should map to meaningful world progression
- No abrupt jumps or hard section boundaries visible to the user
- The system must work flawlessly across desktop and mobile

Technical Architecture

Core Stack: GSAP ScrollTrigger (master orchestrator) + Lenis (smooth scroll) + React Three Fiber (3D world) + Framer Motion (UI reveals).

Master Timeline Structure

Create a single GSAP timeline with ScrollTrigger that maps the entire page scroll (0% to 100%) to the entire journey (Hero through Footer). The timeline is divided into segments corresponding to each section, with overlapping transition zones between them.

Timeline Segments:
| Section | Scroll Range | Duration |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| Hero | 0% - 8% | 8% |
| About | 8% - 18% | 10% |
| Education | 18% - 28% | 10% |
| Experience | 28% - 40% | 12% |
| Skills | 40% - 50% | 10% |
| Certifications | 50% - 55% | 5% |
| Projects | 55% - 68% | 13% |
| Dashboard | 68% - 75% | 7% |
| Blog | 75% - 82% | 7% |
| Testimonials | 82% - 87% | 5% |
| Contact | 87% - 94% | 7% |
| Footer | 94% - 100% | 6% |

Each section transition has a 2-3% overlap zone for blending.

Camera Spline Path

Define a CatmullRom spline through 3D space with control points corresponding to each section. Camera follows this spline as user scrolls.

Spline Control Points (3D positions + look targets):
| Section | Camera Position | Look Target |
|----------|-----------------|-------------|
| Hero | (0, 0, 3) | (0, 0, 0) |
| About | (0, 1, 5) | (0, 0.5, 0) |
| Education | (3, 2, 7) | (1, 0.5, 0) |
| Experience | (0, 3, 8) | (0, 1, -1) |
| Skills | (-3, 2, 7) | (-1, 0.5, 0) |
| Projects | (0, 4, 10) | (0, 1, -2) |
| Dashboard | (2, 2, 6) | (1, 0, -1) |
| Blog | (0, 1, 5) | (0, 0.5, 0) |
| Testimonials | (-2, 1.5, 6) | (-0.5, 0.5, 0) |
| Contact | (0, 2, 7) | (0, 0.5, -1) |
| Footer | (0, 1.5, 5) | (0, 0, 0.5) |

Camera behavior: position interpolated along spline, lookAt smoothly transitions between targets. Additional subtle sway/breathe using sine wave on the look target.

Character Spline Path

Character follows a separate path offset from the camera to create cinematic framing. Character is always visible in frame.

Character Spline Control Points:
| Section | Character Position |
|----------|-------------------|
| Hero | (0, 0, 0) |
| About | (0, 0, -0.5) |
| Education | (1.5, 0, -1) |
| Experience | (0, 0, -1.5) |
| Skills | (-1.5, 0, -1) |
| Projects | (0, 0, -2) |
| Dashboard | (1, 0, -1.5) |
| Blog | (0, 0, -1) |
| Testimonials | (-1, 0, -1) |
| Contact | (0, 0, -0.5) |
| Footer | (0, 0, 0.5) |

Character rotation: automatically faces the direction of movement along the path. Plus idle rotations for looking at interactive objects.

Lenis Smooth Scroll Configuration

```javascript
import Lenis from 'lenis'

const lenis = new Lenis({
  duration: 1.2,
  easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)),
  orientation: 'vertical',
  gestureOrientation: 'vertical',
  smoothWheel: true,
  wheelMultiplier: 1,
  smoothTouch: false,
  touchMultiplier: 2,
  infinite: false,
})
```

Integration: Lenis requestAnimationFrame loop updates GSAP ScrollTrigger. GSAP does not control scroll position directly — Lenis handles smooth scrolling, ScrollTrigger listens to Lenis scroll events.

Section Content Reveal System

Each section has a set of HTML/UI elements (headings, cards, stats) revealed at specific points within its scroll range.

Reveal Approach: Use Framer Motion's useInView or GSAP ScrollTrigger markers within each section's range. Elements animate in with stagger (40-80ms delay) using fade+translateY (30px) combination.

Reveal Timing Per Section:
| Section | First Element | Full Reveal |
|----------|--------------|-------------|
| Hero | 1% | 6% |
| About | 9% | 15% |
| Education | 19% | 25% |
| Experience | 29% | 37% |
| Skills | 41% | 47% |
| Certifications | 50.5% | 53.5% |
| Projects | 56% | 65% |
| Dashboard | 68.5% | 73% |
| Blog | 75.5% | 80% |
| Testimonials | 82.5% | 85.5% |
| Contact | 87.5% | 92% |
| Footer | 94.5% | 98% |

Environment Transition System

Each section's environment (background color, particles, lighting, fog) blends into the next over the transition zones.

Transition Implementation:
- Background color: GSAP timeline animating CSS custom properties or Three.js scene background color
- Particle systems: Crossfade opacity between two particle systems (current section fading out, next section fading in)
- Lighting: Interpolate between ambient/directional light colors and intensities
- Fog: Lerp fog color and density values
- Environment assets: Scale from 0 to 1 for new assets appearing, 1 to 0 for old assets disappearing

All transitions use GSAP .to() or .fromTo() with power2.inOut easing over the transition zone scroll range.

Performance Optimization

- Use GSAP .quickTo() for frequently updated values (camera position, character position) to avoid creating new GSAP tweens each frame
- Throttle Three.js render updates to align with scroll events via requestAnimationFrame
- Pause GSAP timelines and Three.js render loop when tab is hidden (Page Visibility API)
- Use Lenis' onScroll callback with debounce for non-critical updates
- Prefer GSAP's position parameter for timeline sequencing over nesting timelines
- Mobile: Reduce ScrollTrigger refresh frequency, simplify spline paths, lower Lenis duration to 0.8

Mobile Adaptation

- Touch devices: Lenis smoothTouch: false, use native scroll for better feel
- On mobile, reduce scroll range per section (condensed content)
- Camera spline path simplified (fewer control points, closer to character)
- Content reveals faster (less scroll distance between first and full reveal)
- Environment transitions faster (lower transition zone percentage)
- Character may not be visible on very small screens (hide 3D on < 768px or option to view)

Accessibility

- prefers-reduced-motion: Disable Lenis smooth scrolling (native scroll), disable all GSAP animations, simple fade reveals via CSS transitions only
- Keyboard: Arrow keys and Page Up/Down mapped to scroll increments via Lenis
- Screen readers: Content is always in DOM, just visually animated. aria-hidden on 3D canvas.
- Skip link: 'Skip to content' button that disables scroll narrative and jumps to main content

Deliverables

1. Master GSAP timeline structure with all section segments and transition zones
2. Camera spline path definition with 3D control points and look targets
3. Character spline path definition with position and rotation control points
4. Lenis configuration with GSAP ScrollTrigger integration code
5. Section content reveal timing matrix
6. Environment transition implementation (color, particles, lighting, fog lerps)
7. Performance optimization checklist for scroll system
8. Mobile adaptation plan (reduced complexity, native scroll on small screens)
9. Reduced-motion fallback implementation
10. Complete code integration guide for Next.js + React Three Fiber + Lenis + GSAP

prompts.title: Agent Orchestration — Multi-Agent Swarm Execution Pipeline
prompts.prompt:
Role & Goal

You are a Senior Orchestration Architect and Multi-Agent Pipeline Coordinator. Execute all 8 preceding prompts as a coordinated swarm of specialized AI agents. Each prompt targets a specific domain expert. Your role is to import, dispatch, monitor, and integrate results from each agent into a single cohesive portfolio codebase.

Execution Model: Hierarchical Swarm

- You (the Lead Agent) own the pipeline, timeline, and quality gates
- Spawn one sub-agent per prompt in logical dependency order
- Each sub-agent receives its prompt + shared context (tech stack, portfolio data, existing code)
- Sub-agents return: code files, configuration, documentation, or specifications
- You integrate all outputs, resolve conflicts, and verify the build

Agent Pipeline Order & Dependencies

| Step | Agent | Prompt | Depends On | Output |
|------|-------|--------|------------|--------|
| 1 | 3D Character Artist | Prompt 1: 3D Avatar Generation | None | GLTF model, animation clips, textures, LODs |

| 3 | UI/UX Designer | Prompt 3: UI/UX Design System | None (parallel with 1,2) | Design tokens, component specs, Tailwind config |
| 4 | Motion Designer | Prompt 4: Motion Design System | Prompt 3 (needs tokens) | GSAP timelines, easings, choreography doc |
| 5 | Full-Stack Engineer | Prompt 5: SEO/GEO/Security | Prompt 3 (needs structure) | Metadata templates, security headers, Lighthouse plan |

| 7 | Interactive Systems Designer | Prompt 7: Companion Objects | Prompt 1, 6 (needs character + world) | Drone, terminal, scanner, hidden mode specs + code |
| 8 | Scroll Engineering Architect | Prompt 8: Scroll Storytelling | ALL previous prompts | GSAP master timeline, camera spline, Lenis config, reveals |
